svg.title: Batch diffusion sampling and pruning pipeline
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of the full figure: top process flow from Gaussian batch to repopulated batch, lower-left compositional score sampling panel, lower-right local feasibility metric/DDIM inversion panel, dashed zoom connectors, side generated landscape strip, icons, arrows, equations, labels, brackets, gradients, and SAM-confirmed replacements for small icons/arrows/curves.

g.desc: Top frame inventory: left Gaussian input, batch tau(T) gray/noisy bars, batch tau(t) colored bars, small denoising intermediate rounded boxes, batch tau(t-1), predicted clean samples, local feasibility metric bars, min J status icons, elite batch, repopulated batch, arrows and ellipses.

Left panel inventory: tau(t) vertical diffusion strip with colored braces and y labels, local plan diffusion model, score terms feeding a summation node, epsilon output, denoising diffusion box, tau(t-1) strip, top and bottom resampling loop arrows, and magnifier callout.
g.text: Compositional Score Sampling for Global Coherence

g.desc: Right panel inventory: local feasibility metric with DDIM inversion, tau(0) noisy/sample strip and colored braces, image-sample columns y(0), intermediate y(i-1), vertical latent strip, DDIM inversion block, output y(i), blue patterned strip, ellipses, tau(T) noisy bar, Gaussian prior curve, and objective equation.
g.text: Local feasibility metric with DDIM Inversion for Pruning
